description.text:
~We're Hiring Senior Backend Engineer – Let's Build Epic Live Gaming Experiences!~
Want to take full ownership of high-performance web applications? From powerful server-side logic and databases all the way to slick client-side admin interfaces — this is your playground to build, manage, and crush it all!
We welcome backend rockstars from any language — .NET, Go, Python, PHP, Java, C++, you name it!
As long as you can leverage AI to write clean, powerful Node.js (TypeScript) code, we’re obsessed with you!
If you’re a passionate backend expert who lives for exciting, high-impact projects…
we NEED you on our team! Come join the fun!
## Your Epic Responsibilities
1. Deliver rock-solid, super testable, and blazing-fast code that hits the highest quality standards.
2. Team up with us to create addictive live gaming products.
3. Document and maintain software features so clearly that anyone can pick it up later.
4. Design automated tests and absolutely crush unit + integration testing.
## What We’re Looking For
1. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
2. 5+ years of experience building distributed cloud-based products.
3. Proactive mindset with excellent communication and problem-solving superpowers.
4. Strong mastery of PostgreSQL and Redis.
5. Solid experience with Git.
6. Good understanding of DynamoDB or MongoDB.
7. Working knowledge of RabbitMQ or Kafka.
8. Fluency in English (written & spoken).
## Heads Up!
Be ready — the interview will include a live coding test. Time to show off your skills and shine!
